text:
talia-qa: Deploybot blocked v3.9.7 for eu-west-1: SBOM checksum mismatch on registry vs artifacts store + vuln scan shows 1 LOW transitive issue. We have a 1hr change window. Any quick paths?

deploybot: [automated] release v3.9.7 -> gates: SBOM_CHECKSUM: MISMATCH; VULN_SCAN: 1 LOW (transitive). Action: BLOCK (region=eu-west-1). pipeline: /pipelines/8812.

mike-sec: Can someone paste the checksum outputs and cosign verify? If the SBOM exists but checksums diverge we might be able to accept a timeboxed exception with evidence. EU compliance requires artifact-level attestation.

reza-build: I pulled both sides: `aws s3 cp s3://build-sboms/v3.9.7/sbom.json ./sbom-artifact.json` and `registry-cli fetch-manifest registry.redwood/v3.9.7 > manifest.json`. The manifest annotation points to sbom sha256: `sha256:aaaa1111` but artifact store shows `sha256:bbbb2222`. Publish step likely uploaded an older SBOM. cosign verify shows signature present.

fiona-release: Options: (A) block EU and proceed global; (B) attach an evidence bundle and request a timeboxed EU exception for a 2% canary; (C) rollback to v3.9.6. Which is fastest?

talia-qa: The vuln is in a build-only helper; low risk. I'm leaning B if Compliance will sign. I can assemble the bundle now. Commands I ran: ```bash
registry-cli fetch-manifest registry.redwood/v3.9.7 > manifest.json
jq -r '.annotations."io.redwood.sbom_ref"' manifest.json > sbom_ref || true
aws s3 cp "${sbom_ref}" ./sbom-artifact.json || true
sha256sum sbom-artifact.json > artifact.sha256
sha256sum sbom.json > manifest_sha256 || true
cosign verify registry.redwood/v3.9.7 > cosign.out || true
```

mike-sec: Compliance path: we can approve a 48h timeboxed exception for EU if you: 1) upload the evidence bundle to CHG, 2) include root cause and remediation plan with ETA, 3) set auto-rollback to v3.9.6 after 48h if remediation not merged. Release notes must include the discrepancy and the CHG link.

reza-build: I opened PR #224 to add a publish retry that re-attaches the correct SBOM and normalizes checksums. Link: https://git.redwood/infra/publish/pull/224. If merged, we can re-run publish and push corrected manifest. ETA ~30m.

fiona-release: Proposed ops flow: 1) create CHG and upload evidence, 2) request Compliance exception, 3) start controlled EU canary at 2% with tag `v3.9.7-eu-evidence-exc` and strict monitors, 4) if PR #224 merges and SBOMs reconcile, remove exception and proceed.

deploybot: [automated] note: if exception path chosen, set release tag `v3.9.7-eu-evidence-exc` and schedule auto-rollback to v3.9.6 at 48h unless CHG shows remediation merged.

talia-qa: CHG-3770 created: https://internal.redwood/chg/CHG-3770. Evidence uploaded: CHG-3770/evidence.tar.gz includes cosign.out, sbom-artifact.json, manifest.json, checksums. Release note draft: "v3.9.7: EU limited canary due to SBOM checksum mismatch between registry manifest and artifact store; low-risk transitive vuln in build-only helper; publish fix PR #224 opened; auto-rollback scheduled +48h."

mike-sec: Reviewing CHG-3770 now. Will post conditional sign-off if the evidence bundle contains both cosign output and checksum diff with explanation. Need remediation ETA in the ticket.

reza-build: PR #224 merged and publish retriggered. New manifest now references sbom sha256:bbbb2222 which matches artifact store. Pushing cosign verify output to CHG-3770.

deploybot: [automated] re-evaluation: manifest SBOM ref reconciled; SBOM signature verified. EU gate state: PENDING COMPLIANCE ACK.

mike-sec: Verified updated artifact and cosign logs in CHG-3770. Posting sign-off :white_check_mark: Approve 2% EU canary for 2h observation, then ramp per normal if no anomalies. Ensure CHG notes remediation items and close within 48h.

fiona-release: Starting EU canary now as approved. Tagging release `v3.9.7-eu-evidence-exc`. Monitoring dashboards set to 1m granularity for first 30m.

deploybot: [automated] action: proceed rollout -> regions: global-except-eu (full); eu-west-1 (canary 2%). policy: timebox 48h for remediation -> auto-rollback target v3.9.6 if CHG not closed.

talia-qa: Thanks, will watch health metrics and update CHG if anything pops.

mike-sec: Reminder: include the `cosign` outputs and the publish log in CHG before we close the exception.

fiona-release: Will update release notes and close the thread when CHG cleared.
